invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Drawable (as every path checks for non-null before returning style fields).

invariants.expression: result == style.disabledBackground || result == style.focusedBackground || result == style.background
invariants.rationale: The method returns exactly one of these three fields from style.
If the TextField is disabled and disabledBackground is non-null, it is the returned result.

invariants.expression: (!disabled && style.focusedBackground != null && hasKeyboardFocus()) ? result == style.focusedBackground : true
invariants.rationale: If not disabled and focusedBackground is non-null and has focus, that is what is returned.
If not disabled, and either focusedBackground is null or TextField does not have keyboard focus, the result is background.
